integrity: Exact asymptotic proof and two-column law are supplied with a standalone standard-library verifier. Computations corroborate rather than establish the all-n theorem; no external or independent scientific validation has occurred.
limitations: Only fixed column count, independent one-bit stochastic-nearness rounding of constant rank-one matrices; asymptotic optimizer uniqueness is not asserted for all finite row counts; rank does not quantify smallest singular values; literature priority is provisional.
title: A Lambert-W skew in rank restoration by stochastic rounding
